ticket.subject: EU data center timeouts
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

All our workspaces hosted in the EU region have been unreachable since 15:35 UTC.

We see the same from home connections and from our office. Our US workspace still works.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Please confirm and let us know the expected recovery time.

Kind regards,
Leila

label_notes: clean outage (outage-eu-region): a whole region is unreachable, so outage P1; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
